propositions: rebar-debug must record the originating ticket (caused_by link) before closing a bug, tracing back to the introducing commit rather than discarding provenance

the fallback blame derivation incorrectly attributes defects to the file's primary author rather than the actual defect introducer, and cannot detect unmet-obligation cases where fix site and cause site differ

the skill must provide an explicit attribution step in Phase 1 Stage 3 that identifies the defect origin, handles four resolution types (regression, unmet obligation, omission, unattributable), and gates the bug close on this finding
the --caused-by flag must be supplied on close even when the caused_by link was already recorded via rebar link earlier, as _apply_caused_by currently adds a second guessed edge unconditionally

worktree bootstrap must use make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add to provision the virtualenv, and all commands must run with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
